# Gasiin Enterprise

> Gasiin Enterprise is an early-stage, integrated livestock feed and livestock agribusiness with its office in Shacab Area, Hargeisa. It is building a supply of graded quality hay, vacuum-wrapped silage and species-specific concentrate feeds for commercial dairy, poultry and pre-export livestock producers, and has piloted fattening sheep, goats and cattle for export in Arabsiyo district. "Gasiin" is the Somali word for feed or food. Tagline: "Boosting livestock productivity & profitability".

## Products
- Gasiin Hay: graded, sun-cured, dust-free hay in 20–25 kg bales.
- Gasiin Silage: fermented, vacuum-wrapped silage, in wrapped bales (about 50 kg) and bulk.
- Gasiin Feeds: species-specific concentrates in 25 kg and 50 kg bags: dairy ration, poultry feed (starter, grower, layer/broiler), and sheep and cattle fattening ration.

## Services
- Livestock fattening for export (sheep, goats, cattle).
- Out-grower contract farming for fodder.
- On-farm feeding trials and nutrition advice.
- Feed supply to livestock quarantine stations and export yards (being set up, starting with Berbera).

## Quality (being put in place)
Moisture checks on incoming raw materials, batch coding, laboratory nutrient and aflatoxin testing; formulas aligned with East African Standards EAS 75 (cattle feed) and EAS 90 (poultry feed) and Codex Alimentarius feed-safety guidelines.

## Founders
- Ahmed Hersi Osman, Co-Founder and Managing Director: 12 years of leadership in agribusiness, livestock trade and commercial operations.
- Kaisar Omer, Co-Founder and Business Development Manager: more than 20 years of management and leadership experience, especially in the production sector; oversees day-to-day running of the enterprise.
